description: This file defines an interface 'FileRemove' for managing file removal operations within the CMS content module of the project. It declares methods for removing individual files and all files associated with a merchant store.

classes.name: FileRemove
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for removing files from the CMS content system.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specified file associated with a merchant store, identified by content type and filename.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a specified merchant store.
